description: Adds a row to the Claims tab for a claim that was not filed, so every decision has a record. Writes one row per run. A repeat call writes nothing. Refuses when a claim was already filed in this run, or when the status doesn't match the latest check_claim result.

reason.description: The reason in one sentence. Use the reason from check_claim unchanged when there is one.

unitNumber.description: The unit number, or an empty string when the technician never gave one.

component.description: The component group, or an empty string when unknown.

failureDescription.description: A short description of the reported failure.
